name: Fuzzy Previous Version Match Character Count Step
overview: Counts the characters in text units whose top alternate translation is a `FUZZY_PREVIOUS_VERSION` match — a fuzzy (partial) match that, in addition, comes from the immediately preceding version of the same document. The match must originate in the version directly before the one being leveraged (for example, when leveraging v4 the match comes from v3, not v2 or v1). It is the character-counting counterpart of the Fuzzy Previous Version Match Word Count Step, differing only in that it tallies characters rather than words.
processingNotes: Operates per segment: it inspects the first (top-ranked) `AltTranslation` on each target segment's `AltTranslationsAnnotation` and counts a segment only when that match type is exactly `FUZZY_PREVIOUS_VERSION`.
Counting is performed on the **source** text, not the target — the character total reflects the source volume leveraged at this match level.
Uses the GMX-V character counter; the only behavioural difference from the word-count variant is words versus characters.
Counts only translatable text units; empty text units and non-translatable ones are skipped.

Results are stored as annotations on filter events and aggregated to the configured levels (text unit, group, document, sub-document, batch item, batch); the step produces no output document of its own.

Belongs to the `OKAPI_CHARACTER_COUNTS` category group. The `CategoryResolver` keeps only the highest-ranked matching category per segment — `FUZZY_PREVIOUS_VERSION` ranks above plain `FUZZY` but below `FUZZY_UNIQUE_ID` and all exact categories.
